text.description_html:
NGP-SLAL-250-BP-2DR-72, 72" Double Door Pocket Door Track and Hardware Pack

This is a National Guard aluminum pocket door top mount track system for a double door. Kit includes (1) Track - Mill Finish, (2) Universal Hardware Packs. Each Consist Of: (2) Ball Bearing Heavy Duty Hangers, (2) Snap-In Door Brackets, (2) In-Track Stops, (1) Angle Stop, (1) Bumper Stop, (1) Door Guide, Heavy Duty Floor Guides

Features for National Guard SLAL-250-PD Pocket Door Track System

  • Commercial Grade for 1-3/8" To 1-3/4" Doors
  • For Sliding Doors up to 250 lbs. Each
  • ANSI/BHMA A156.14 Grade 1 Certified to 100,000 Cycles Including Soft Close Feature
  • Hangers with Heavy-Duty Ball Bearing Wheels
  • Meets ADA Push Force Requirements
  • 5-Year Warranty
  • Finish: Mill Aluminum
  • ANSI/BHMA CERTIFIED. Certified Sliding Door Hardware complies with American National Standard for Sliding and Folding Door Hardware ANSI/BHMA A156.14 Grade 1 100,000 cycles and is listed in the BHMA Certified Product Directory.

Special Ordered Item. No Returns.
